row.title: Executor trailers ride in the PR body because squash merges take it
row.body: The repo squashes with PR_BODY as the message, so trailers only on the branch commit were lost at merge; standards --commits now fails an executor merge that lacks them (ZHC-R7 #2672).
row.probe: grep:foundation/executor.py::ZHC-R7: squash merges take the PR body
